Lesson_X_Parabola_Generator_Info.keywords: LessonX, Parabola, Gradio, SQLite, Pandas, Plotly, LDD, HeadlessTesting, SemanticExoskeleton
Lesson_X_Parabola_Generator_Info.terms: config.json stores a/c/x_min/x_max; parabola_points stores SQL-backed x/y rows; app_x.log stores IMP telemetry.
Lesson_X_Parabola_Generator_Info.annotation: Isolated educational application that generates y = ax^2 + c points, persists them to SQLite, displays SQL data in Gradio, and draws Plotly figures through headless-testable handlers.

BusinessScenarios.Scenario: User -> inputs a,c,x_min,x_max and clicks Generate Data -> config.json is updated, points are generated, SQLite is replaced, DataFrame and friendly status are returned.
User -> temporarily sets x_min greater than x_max and clicks Generate Data -> handler logs IMP:10 and returns an empty x/y table plus friendly status without overwriting config.json.
User -> clicks Draw Graph -> SQLite points are loaded and rendered as a Plotly Figure.
AI agent -> calls handlers directly in pytest -> verifies DataFrame/Figure types and LDD IMP:7-10 traces without browser/server startup.
